props.gloss_en: the mishnah: [ashes] on the head of the Nasi and of the av beit din, and [then] each one puts [ashes] on his own head -- the Nasi first (וַהֲדַר תני, 15b.12)
Rebbi: in greatness one begins with the greatest
and in a curse one begins with the least
in greatness one begins with the greatest, as it says 'and Moses said to Aharon and to Elazar and to Itamar' (Lev 10:6)
and in a curse one begins with the least -- for first the serpent was cursed, then Eve was cursed, then Adam was cursed
this is a distinction for them, for [the people] say to them: you are worthy to ask mercy for us all
